## Proposal Type

- [ ] General knowledge pattern (`knowledge/`)
- [ ] Repeatable agent workflow skill (`skills/`)

## Rationale

Explain why this pattern is reusable across references (or why a new repeatable capability merits a Skill rather than a knowledge pattern).

## Provenance & Rights

Confirm that no copyrighted third-party reference assets or private user taste files are included.
